title: Request traces
intro: Find database calls, logs, and errors that share a trace ID.
limits: Recorded events only. Sampling, redaction, retention, and dropped events may leave gaps. The record list is newest received first.
setup: Use the Node SDK withSpan helper or Fastify tracing hooks, then follow View request trace from a recorded event or database call.
invalid: Enter a nonzero trace ID with 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
empty: No records for this trace in the selected window.
noTiming: No usable span timings in the loaded records. Correlation-only traces still appear below.
partial: More records are available. Load them below to expand this waterfall.
missingParent: Parent span is missing or invalid
timingLimits: Recorded spans ordered by start time. Database starts are estimated from completion time and duration. Clocks across services may differ; this is not a guarantee of a complete request.
timingRange: {count, plural, one {# recorded span} other {# recorded spans}} over {duration} ms
